notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped attribute update and retraction surface when no recipient is eligible. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies retraction-handle return and terminalization without recipient fan-out and without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues and Retract with time advance and no eligible FederateAmbassador recipient
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped attribute update/retraction declarations
